constraints.note: the 32 expressed here are the subset of the 104 falsifiable rows that translate into the checker DSL; coverage is reported by analysis/build_contract_json.py rather than implied
constraints.firstRunNote: five failed, and all five were defects in the checking expressions rather than in the model: `inside` compares three axes where a coaxial pair needs two, and `flush` compares hi-to-hi where an abutment is lo-to-hi. Operators `concentric`, `meets` and `sub` were added afterwards, so this is not a clean first pass and is not reported as one

joints.note: a pistol has two articulated parts, the hammer and the trigger. Nova3D's figure is 59 joints, a different order of magnitude

locality.note: only the two count handles are generation parameters, where the handle is a term in the code that produces the geometry. The other six are transforms scoped to named subtrees, which is the weaker form
contractRowsFalsified: H1 fixes tube-fore min.x while also asking mid-band to translate, and that face is the mid-band front face (both 110.3 mm). Not jointly satisfiable by any model
H4 names only the cutouts as moving, but the struts are the arcs between them and cannot survive a count change
locality.foundBy: implementing section 8, not by reading it. Neither was caught by the 25-defect adversarial audit of the same document
